statement: A nonlinear software transform can generate spectral intermodulation components in synthetic data.
null_hypothesis: Detected components may originate in detector or analysis nonlinearity rather than a material effect.
observable: Spectral peaks in toy synthetic data (not measured laboratory power).
comparison: Compare ideal linear control, nonlinear detector blank, and simulated study.
falsification_rule: A material-specific interpretation is not established if a matched blank reproduces the peak or if calibrated energy accounting is absent.
